titulo: Study to Define Optimal IGF-1 Monitoring in Children Treated With NutropinAq

braco.texto:
Patients received daily subcutaneous (s.c.) injections of NutropinAq 10 milligrams (mg)/2 milliliters (mL) for 6 months. The therapeutic daily doses administered were as follows:

* GHD patients: 0.025 - 0.035 mg/ kilogram (kg) bodyweight
* TS patients: up to 0.05 mg/kg bodyweight
* CRI patients: up to 0.05 mg/kg bodyweight

Patients visited the study clinic for a baseline visit and for 2 other visits every 3 months
braco.textoPt:
Os pacientes receberam injeções subcutâneas (s.c.) diárias de NutropinAq 10 miligramas (mg) / 2 mililitros (mL) durante 6 meses. As doses terapêuticas diárias administradas foram as seguintes:

* Pacientes com DGH: 0,025 - 0,035 mg/quilograma (kg) de peso corporal
* Pacientes com ST: até 0,05 mg/kg de peso corporal
* Pacientes com IRC: até 0,05 mg/kg de peso corporal

Os pacientes visitaram a clínica do estudo para uma visita inicial e para outras 2 visitas a cada 3 meses
